failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Linux, browser-debugger)
failed_jobs.reason: Both failing tests time out (~299,680ms / ~299,792ms) waiting for the Blazor WASM root debug session for 'hosted-global' and 'hosted-per-page'. The PR only modifies Directory.Packages.props (a single version bump), which is unrelated to the VS Code extension's Blazor WASM debugger E2E infrastructure. This matches a known recurring flaky pattern in the memory branch (issue #20184) with 4 prior occurrences.
